import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET,json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
def cells(path):
 result={}
 for e in ET.parse(path).getroot():
  if e.tag.endswith('text'):
   result[(int(e.attrib['x'])//9,(int(e.attrib['y'])-14)//18)]=(e.text,e.attrib.get('fill','').lower())
 return result
out=[]
for w,h in [(60,20),(80,24),(100,30),(120,40),(160,60)]:
 ref=cells(root/f'dist/demo-design-preview-slop/target/stats-rebuild/captures/welcome-{w}x{h}.svg')
 actual=cells(root/f'@prime/evidence/ui/repair-after/welcome-{w}x{h}.svg')
 # Footer has real offline/model/effort state instead of demo model data.
 diffs=[{'cell':k,'reference':ref.get(k),'actual':actual.get(k)} for k in set(ref)|set(actual) if k[1]<h-1 and ref.get(k)!=actual.get(k)]
 out.append({'size':f'{w}x{h}','non_footer_differences':diffs})
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(any(x['non_footer_differences'] for x in out))
